semantics.providerId: Stable provider identity used for pair normalization; aliases never create a second provider.
semantics.familyId: Root provider-lineage family used for independence normalization. Provider-specific names never create a new root lineage.
semantics.independenceGroup: Lineage/correlation group used by the strict provider-pair gate.
semantics.lineageStatus: declared means the retained evidence states the relevant upstream; correlated or unknown is not independent evidence.
semantics.reuse: This registry normalizes identity only; it never promotes a candidate or authorizes provider-pair reuse.

official-hoyoverse.label: HoYoverse first-party publication
official-hoyoverse.acquisitionMethod: official page or official release notice capture
official-hoyoverse.revisionSystem: entry/release locator plus captured raw digest
official-hoyoverse.releaseSystem: Genshin game version explicitly stated by the official artifact
official-hoyoverse.risk: Official pages and notices can have partial field coverage; each record still needs a version-scoped immutable locator.

GenshinData-derived.label: GenshinData-derived root lineage
GenshinData-derived.revisionSystem: git revision and materialized file digest
GenshinData-derived.releaseSystem: provider manifest when bound to an exact revision
GenshinData-derived.lineage: Root group containing the community-maintained localized raw/datamine projection and correlated GenshinData-derived projections.
GenshinData-derived.risk: A strict version manifest for genshin-db does not make Genshin Optimizer or another member of this root lineage an independent provider.

gcsim-implementation.label: genshinsim/gcsim implementation
gcsim-implementation.releaseSystem: gcsim release tag; Genshin version manifest presently missing
gcsim-implementation.risk: The pinned release identifies repository bytes but currently lacks an explicit Genshin patch binding.

gachabase-versioned-data.label: Gachabase versioned snapshots
gachabase-versioned-data.acquisitionMethod: versioned provider snapshot and delta capture
gachabase-versioned-data.revisionSystem: provider revision number plus snapshot/release digest
gachabase-versioned-data.releaseSystem: Gachabase release and explicit version-to-version delta
gachabase-versioned-data.lineage: Versioned provider snapshots and diff graph; extraction-stage upstream is not fully disclosed in retained evidence.
gachabase-versioned-data.risk: The Xiao C1 decision is candidate-scoped; unreviewed fields cannot inherit the pair decision.

kqm-community-theorycrafting.label: KQM Theorycrafting Library
kqm-community-theorycrafting.lineage: Community-submitted theorycrafting knowledge reviewed by KQM theorycrafting editors.
kqm-community-theorycrafting.risk: The pinned artifact file has no provider-authored manifest binding its exact bytes to a Genshin patch.

teyvatguide-upstream-undisclosed.label: BTMuli/TeyvatGuide
teyvatguide-upstream-undisclosed.lineage: Processed JSON; TGAssistant/Snap.Metadata route is suggested, but source-owned extraction lineage is incomplete.
teyvatguide-upstream-undisclosed.risk: An explicit 6.7 resource release does not prove independence from GenshinData-derived providers.

provider-frontier.label: Current primary/community provider frontier
provider-frontier.lineage: Policy context representing the finite source-search frontier, not a factual provider.
provider-frontier.risk: Cannot itself satisfy a field-level provider gate.

contract-gate.label: Strict DataContract gate
contract-gate.lineage: Repository verification policy context, not a game-data provider.
contract-gate.risk: Cannot be treated as a source of game facts.

local-v2.label: Repository-local v2 projection
local-v2.lineage: Repository-generated comparison target; not an external provider and never sufficient for source independence.
local-v2.risk: Local EffectSpec values may be compared to an external claim but cannot satisfy the two-provider gate.

current primary and community provider f.canonicalName: Current primary and community provider frontier
